_comment: A pointer package. archeus is a Python program; this exists so the name
on Packagist resolves to the real project rather than to nothing.
Packagist publishes from the ROOT of a git repository, so this file
cannot be submitted from here: it has to be the composer.json of a
small repository of its own (babarmuhammad/archeus-packagist or
similar). Putting it at the root of the main repository instead would
make every PHP tool that walks a checkout believe this is a PHP project.
name: babarmuhammad/archeus
description: Pointer package: archeus is a Python tool - install it with `pipx install archeus`. The memory and workspace layer for AI coding agents.
